summary: Iteration 12 — Full end-to-end LIVE dry-run on PREVIEW in Stripe TEST mode. All 9 chain links GREEN: restaurant onboarding, menu, driver onboarding, admin approval+go-online, order placement, Stripe TEST checkout session created + card 4242 charged via Playwright on Stripe-hosted page (payment_status=paid, status=complete), driver assignment, full status lifecycle (confirmed → preparing → ready → picked_up), proof-of-delivery upload, order=delivered with actual_delivery_time set, and driver wallet/earnings credited. Backend pytest 20/20 PASS. Fixed 2 in-scope backend bugs found en route (Mongo ObjectId leak on /api/restaurants/{id}/menu and datetime-not-JSON-serializable in /api/orders/create WebSocket broadcast).

checklist.menu_visible: GREEN — POST /api/menu-items + GET /api/restaurants/{id}/menu returns items (after _id fix)
checklist.admin_approval: GREEN — POST /api/admin/drivers/{id}/approve → /auth/me user_type=driver, can go online
checklist.stripe_test_payment_captured: GREEN — Playwright filled card 4242 4242 4242 4242 12/34 CVC 123 on https://checkout.stripe.com → status.payment_status=paid, status=complete, redirected to /payment/success; order.payment_status=paid
checklist.driver_assignment: GREEN — driver_id assigned (auto-assign on creation works; deterministic per-test reassignment used)
checklist.delivery_completion: GREEN — PUT status lifecycle 200 each step; POST /orders/{id}/proof 200; order.status=delivered, actual_delivery_time set
checklist.payout_earnings_record: GREEN — driver wallet endpoint returns 200; _credit_driver_on_delivery credits driver_wallets on transition to delivered

minor.issue: Order model does not expose paid_at field (set by checkout/status path but stripped on serialization). Cosmetic — payment_status='paid' is exposed and correct.

Auto-assigns to ANY online driver (db.drivers.find_one({status:'online'})) without geo/availability filtering — can pick a stale driver from prior runs. Use /find-driver + /accept-driver flow for production, or filter by current_location near pickup.
Pre-existing 500 (Mongo _id ObjectId) — carried over from iter9/10/11, not in this iteration's scope.

integration_issues.issue: When user lands on /payment/success without a valid frontend session (e.g. via direct Stripe redirect in a fresh browser), the SPA bounces to /login instead of polling /api/payments/checkout/status with the session_id. Payment is still captured server-side; this only affects the UI confirmation experience.

action_items: (Optional, polish) Add 'paid_at' to Order pydantic model so GET /orders/{id} surfaces it.

(Recommended) Improve auto-driver selection on POST /orders/create — currently picks first 'status:online' driver in DB regardless of location/availability; switch to _find_nearby_drivers/_score_driver_for_pickup or drop auto-assign and require explicit /find-driver + /accept-driver.
(Optional) Make /payment/success route handle un-authenticated polling so a direct Stripe redirect can still display a 'Payment received' confirmation.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: GET /api/restaurants/{id}/menu returned raw Mongo docs containing ObjectId _id → 500. Fixed with projection {_id: 0}.

BUG FIXED: POST /api/orders/create called json.dumps(order.dict()) for WebSocket broadcast — datetime fields blew up the response with 500 even though the order was inserted. Fixed by passing through prepare_for_mongo + default=str.
POST /payments/checkout/session correctly trusts ONLY the server-side order.total (no client-supplied amount); marks transaction 'initiated' and persists session_id.
GET /payments/checkout/status/{session_id} is idempotent — uses {payment_status: {$ne:'paid'}} guard before flipping order to paid. Verified working with real Stripe test charge.
admin_approve_driver atomically flips drivers.status='active' AND users.user_type='driver'.
_credit_driver_on_delivery credits both legacy driver_wallets and in-app wallet on order=delivered transition.

Two production-impacting bugs were fixed in server.py during this run (menu _id leak + order create datetime). Twilio SMS/WhatsApp, CariPay payouts, and Stripe Identity hosted flow remain MOCKED per request — not retested. /payment/success route bounce-to-login is a small UI polish item; the payment itself is captured.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Menu 500: get_restaurant_menu projected raw Mongo docs with ObjectId _id; FastAPI's default JSON encoder cannot serialize ObjectId. Mitigation: project {_id:0}. 2) Order create 500: create_new_order broadcast `json.dumps(order.dict())` directly on Pydantic order containing tz-aware datetimes; json.dumps cannot serialize datetime. Mitigation: prepare_for_mongo + default=str.
